title: Both field designers author `placeholder`, a key FieldSchema rejects by name — but the designer's own preview renders it, so this is a contract question not a deletion
body:
Found while implementing #4644 (retire the `Indexed` toggle); filed unassigned rather than folded into that PR, because the correct form is **not** mechanically pinned the way `indexed`'s was. Backlink: PR #4675.

## Measured

Against the `@objectstack/spec` 17.0.0-rc.6 installed in this repo, probing `FieldSchema.safeParse({ name:'foo', label:'Foo', type:'text',  })`:

| key | verdict |
| --- | --- |
| _(control, no extra key)_ | success |
| `indexed` | `unrecognized_keys` — handled by #4644 |
| **`placeholder`** | **`unrecognized_keys`** |
| `externalId` | success |
| `trackHistory` | success |
| `hidden`, `readonly`, `unique` | success |

The `placeholder` rejection carries its own prescription:

```
Unrecognized key(s) on this field: `placeholder`.
  • never a FieldSchema key. Author hint text through `inlineHelpText` or
    `description`. Until #4001 closed this shape these were dropped silently —
    the field was still created, minus whatever the key was meant to
    constrain, protect or compute.
```

So the same 422 (`INVALID_METADATA`) that #4644 documents for `indexed` is reachable by typing into the **Placeholder** box, on the same `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/:name` route.

## Where it is authored

Both field designers, plus the surrounding write paths:

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` — the `designer.field.placeholder` text field in the ADVANCED section, `patchDef({ placeholder: … })`
- `packages/plugin-designer/src/FieldDesigner.tsx` — the `placeholder` entry in the type-specific section
- `packages/plugin-designer/src/MetadataFieldsPage.tsx` — `toDesignerField` / `fromDesignerField`
- `packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.ts` — `FieldMetadataPayload.placeholder`, `toFieldPayload`
- `packages/app-shell/src/utils/metadataConverters.ts` — `MetadataField.placeholder`, `toFieldDefinition`
- `packages/types/src/designer.ts` — `DesignerFieldDefinition.placeholder`
- label keys: `designer.field.placeholder`, `appDesigner.fieldDesigner.placeholder`, and `placeholder` in all ten locale packs

## Why this is NOT the #4644 treatment

`indexed` was inert everywhere in this repo — nothing read it, so retiring the control cost no capability. `placeholder` is different: it is genuinely **consumed by the designer's own form preview**.

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/object-fields-bridge.ts` maps it in and back out:

```ts
// buildFieldsBridge
placeholder: typeof def?.placeholder === 'string' ? def.placeholder : undefined,
// serializeDesignerField
if (f.placeholder) out.placeholder = f.placeholder;
```

so an author who types a placeholder **sees it render** in the preview, and only discovers on save that it cannot be persisted. Deleting the control therefore removes a visibly-working affordance, which is a product decision rather than a contract clean-up.

## The options (not decided here)

- **A. Retire the control**, matching #4644 / the #4001 / #2377 doctrine — a designer must not offer a key the contract refuses. The spec's own message names the replacements, and `ObjectFieldInspector` already renders `inlineHelpText` right there, so authors are not left without a hint-text surface. Cost: the preview loses per-field placeholder rendering.
- **B. Re-route the control to write `inlineHelpText`.** Keeps the affordance, but it would collide with the existing `inlineHelpText` control (two boxes writing one key), and `inlineHelpText` is help text, not in-input placeholder text — different rendering semantics.
- **C. Add `placeholder` to `FieldSchema` in `objectstack`.** Only correct if there is measured pull for field-level placeholder as real, applied behaviour; otherwise it grows the declared surface ahead of any consumer, which the #7176 doctrine refuses from the producer side.

Deciding needs a measurement this card does not have: whether anything **outside the designer preview** applies a field-level `placeholder` at render time (the form/field renderers in `packages/fields`, `packages/plugin-form`), and whether any example app or real deployment authors one.

Whatever is chosen, the stale-draft half of #4644 applies identically: objects already carrying `placeholder` keep failing every save until the key is stripped on load.

Refs: #4644 (sibling retirement, same ADVANCED section), PR #4675 (where this was measured), objectstack#4001 (silent drop → loud rejection), objectstack#2377.

---

**2026-08-16 ruling: Option C** (see ruling comment) — the producer moves; implementation filed at destination.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#9019
